title: 夹镜鸣琴 Jiajing Mingqin
subtitle: Chia Ching Ming Ch'in (The Double Mirror and the Sound of the Lute) · Yuanming Yuan

model.line: 11 boxes stand in this compound, 10 on blocks drawn on the plan, 1 assumed. Its halls are listed below.

evidence.title: 御製夾鏡鳴琴詞（調寄水仙子）（圓明園四十景詩）
evidence.excerpt_zh:
乾隆九年 御製夾鏡鳴琴詞（調寄水仙子）
取李青蓮兩水夾明鏡詩意架虹橋一道上搆傑閣俯瞰澄泓畫欄倒影旁厓懸瀑水衝激石罅琤琮自鳴猶識成連遺響
垂絲風裏木蘭船拍拍飛鳬破渚煙臨淵無意漁人羡空明水與天　琴心莫説當年移情逺不在絃付與成連
evidence.summary: After 李白's line on two waters holding a bright mirror: an arched bridge with a tall pavilion looks down on clear water. A cascade from the cliff beside rings on the rock, and he recalls the music of 成連.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 夹镜鸣琴
evidence.excerpt_zh: 别有洞天迤西為夾鏡鳴琴南為聚逺樓東為廣育宫前建坊座後為凝祥殿宫東為南屏晚鐘又東度橋為西山入畫為山容水態夾鏡鳴琴之西為湖山在望為佳山水為洞裏長春（圓圓明園册）臣等謹按夾鏡鳴琴四十景之一額為皇上御書廣育宫奉碧霞元君殿額曰恩光仁照與西山入畫湖山在望佳山水洞裏長春諸額皆世宗御書廣育宫前坊額曰含𢎞光大曰品物咸亨與凝祥殿南屏晩鐘諸額皆皇上御書凝祥殿聫曰茂育恩覃昭聖感資生徳溥配坤元亦御書
evidence.summary: West of 别有洞天: 夾鏡鳴琴, with 聚逺樓, 廣育宫 (to 碧霞元君) and its arch and 凝祥殿, 南屏晚鐘, 西山入畫, 山容水態, 湖山在望, 佳山水 and 洞裏長春.

evidence.title: 湖山在望
evidence.locator: v3 p.57, under 夹镜鸣琴; source ref 1-178
evidence.excerpt_zh: 草亭虚敞近湖滨，旷览澄潭玉镜陈。山影印川晴旭叠，波光罨画晚风皴。白云几缕萦峰额，红叶一林绘岸漘。福地豫游蒙圣泽，仙寰驻景小阳春。
evidence.summary: Poem 湖山在望 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1796, filed by the editors under 夹镜鸣琴.

evidence.title: 湖山在望
evidence.locator: v3 p.58, under 夹镜鸣琴; source ref 1-238
evidence.excerpt_zh: 南北界湖山向背，傍汀移棹境全更。目谋心赏奚同异，有触成因幻想生。山色如如原不动，水含叠叠浪花催。何虚何实强分别，过眼烟云是本来。
evidence.summary: Poem 湖山在望 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1797, filed by the editors under 夹镜鸣琴.

evidence.title: Scene 35, 夹镜鸣琴 Jiajing Mingqin
evidence.excerpt_other: A deep well can still be found on the top of this hill where the water was drawn by workmen to supply the music of the waterfall.
evidence.summary: A pavilion on a bridge on the south side of 福海, overlooking water both ways, near a waterfall running down from a temple-crowned hill. A deep well on the hilltop, seen by Malone, supplied the fall by hand.

evidence.title: Site status table, about 2011: scattered remains only
evidence.summary: Scenes with only scattered, incomplete building remains in the same table. 方壶胜境 is listed separately as the one with fairly complete remains not yet tidied up. 紫碧山房, 舍卫城 and 如园 have been dug since.

evidence.title: 夹镜鸣琴; 平湖秋月, yaffin 系列11
evidence.summary: Lead: 夹镜鸣琴, 4,000 m2, south shore of 福海, Yongzheng date, from a Li Bai line on two waters and twin bridges. 平湖秋月, 20,000 m2, north shore, named after the West Lake view, Yongzheng date, three-bay main hall.

evidence.title: 广育宫 (S47 section 2.12)
evidence.summary: On a hill east of 夹镜鸣琴, in pines, facing north in its own court: a pailou, gate hall and the three-bay hip-and-gable main hall 凝祥殿 with side halls. Yellow tile on the album, rare among the shrines. Its goddess 碧霞元君 was prayed to for children; palace women crossed 福海 by boat to it, and a 过皇会 was held nearby on her birthday.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 夹镜鸣琴
evidence.summary: A Yongzheng scene on the south shore: a double-eaved square bridge-pavilion, with 聚远楼 across the water, and 广育宫 to the east for the goddess 碧霞元君. Then 南屏晚钟, 西山入画 (rebuilt about 1763 as the five-bay 开鉴堂, later 渊渟镜澈), 湖山在望 and others.
